text:
maria: Quick kickoff — we need to get Redwood listed on AWS/GCP/Azure. Scope: images/artifacts, legal EULA + billing info, trial SKUs, packaging (terraform/helm), and docs quickstart. Who can own which cloud? :wave:
aj: I can own AWS AMIs + marketplace product setup. Will need the IAM role we agreed on and an S3 bucket for the manifest. ETA EOW.
devon: Legal here — I'll need the proposed EULA text, company VAT/tax ids, and a list of supported countries. Also flagging export-controls questionnaire.
sam: Product: I'll handle packaging policy (trial length, SKU mapping). Proposal: 14-day trial + metered seats. Any blockers?
tina: DevEx: I can start the quickstart and examples. Need sample Terraform snippet and an API key flow example. Will stub docs repo.
aj: For AWS, manifest example — sharing minimal structure now so infra can prep S3 and roles:
```json
{
  "product": "redwood-inference",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "artifacts": {
    "images": {
      "us-east-1": "ami-0abc12345EXAMPLE",
      "eu-west-1": "ami-0def67890EXAMPLE"
    },
    "installer": "s3://redwood-marketplace/installers/1.0.0/"
  }
}
```
aj: Also need list of account IDs that need publisher permissions.
devon: Noted. Also request: any third-party OSS deps must have licenses included in the package. Please add a LICENSES.txt to the artifact bundle.
ops-bot: Reminder: please create a #marketplace-wip channel if not present and upload manifests before EOD.
maria: Thanks. Quick owners check: AWS = aj, GCP = sam (can you take images + packaging?), Azure = ? (any volunteers)
sam: I can do GCP images + packaging. Azure I can kick off but would prefer infra support for image validation.
aj: I'll coordinate with infra on cross-region AMIs and share IAM role ARNs. Tagging @tina for docs once AMIs are stable.
tina: Perfect — I'll draft the quickstart with a sample curl + terraform snippet. Will reuse the product SKU names from sam.
maria: Action items and deadlines: aj (AWS AMIs + manifest + account ARNs) by 2025-03-12 EOD, sam (GCP images + package mapping) by 2025-03-12 EOD, devon (EULA + export questionnaire + LICENSES.txt requirements) by 2025-03-10, tina (docs skeleton + quickstart) by 2025-03-09. Sync check-in Tue 9am PT in #partnerships. Ping me if blockers. :calendar: :thumbsup:
